item.title: Concern for Queen Elizabeth II as the Royal Family gather at Balmoral - Royalty Magazine

item.title: Royalty Magazine: Volume 2905: Queen Elizabeth II: A Tribute - Royalty Magazine
item.description: The passing of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II on September 8, 2022, saw an outpouring of respect and affection. The Second Elizabethan Age spanned seven decades, but the life of service stretches back even further to the mid 1930s, when the teenage Princess Elizabeth became Heir Apparent to her father, King George VI. item.title: Royalty Magazine Vol.2910 - Royalty Magazine
item.description: The Proclamation of King Frederik X on January 14, 2024, was a moment that came upon the Danish people suddenly. Queen Margrethe’s announcement of her abdication just two weeks previously had been a shock. The much admired monarch was quitting the stage as the passing years had taken their toll.
